summary.whatChanges: Bumps pnpm from 9.12.2 to 10.33.1 in root and example packages, updates example CI to pnpm/action-setup@v5, fixes the coverage flag passthrough in CI, excludes coverage output from coverage globs, imports describe from vitest, and makes the OpenAPI CLI create missing output directories before writing.
behaviorChanges: The openapi CLI now creates the output file's parent directories recursively instead of failing when the target directory does not exist
Repo requires pnpm ^10.33.1; installs with pnpm 9 now fail the engines check
Example CI workflows resolve pnpm via action-setup v5 from packageManager instead of a pinned 8.5.1
CI test run passes --coverage to vitest directly rather than through the `--` separator
Coverage reports no longer include files under coverage/ directories
risks: The pnpm 9 to 10 major bump can change lockfile format, hoisting and lifecycle-script defaults, potentially breaking installs for contributors and consumers
pnpm/action-setup@v5 without a pinned version relies entirely on the packageManager field; example packages pinned to 10.33.1 may diverge from the root
mkdirSync with recursive:true silently creates arbitrary directory trees from user-supplied --output paths
Dropping `--` in the CI test command assumes the pnpm 10 argument-forwarding behavior; the flag could be misrouted under other pnpm versions
